question_text: How should the platform transform a bounded research question plus evidence into canonical research-tool input?
goal: Produce a canonical research problem packet for the research tool.
decision_target: whether to build a shared question_to_research_problem_transform surface
decision_consequence: changes whether the upstream question/evidence/research handoff can be automated safely
blocked_work_if_unanswered: cannot confidently wire the upstream question-tool into evidence-search and research orchestration
why_now: The design review loop now checks artifact-level readiness for the upstream handoff.
expected_downstream_change: Enables runner-driven handoff from question/evidence into research.
